name: pulse-monitor
description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with alerts and a public status page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pulse/web" "npm run dev -w @pulse/worker"
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @pulse/web" "npm run start -w @pulse/worker"
